title: Contact and Support
description: A clearer support page for Star Atlas with distinct paths for player help, community guidance, press inquiries, and marketplace-related questions.
heroTitle: Support should feel immediate, calm, and easy to route.
heroSummary: This page replaces dead-end contact patterns with distinct support paths so visitors can tell where to go without guessing.
utilityLine: Forms should only appear here if they are fully working and context-aware. Otherwise direct visitors into the right maintained destination.

heroMedia.label: Support hub
heroMedia.caption: A premium support experience starts with obvious routing and less friction.

heroPanel.title: Tell people exactly where they are going.
heroPanel.body: External destinations are now clearly framed, and each support option is tied to a distinct type of need so visitors do not bounce between dead ends.

cards.title: Help Center
cards.body: Use the support knowledge base and player-help workflows for account, gameplay, and onboarding issues.

cards.title: Discord
cards.body: Best for live community conversation, quick peer help, and shared discovery.

cards.title: Contact page
cards.body: Use the direct outreach path when the issue requires staff visibility beyond self-serve support.

cards.title: Market and asset exploration
cards.body: For economy and asset questions, it is often helpful to route visitors straight into the marketplace surface with context.

items.question: Why not put a general form in the hero?
items.answer: Because undifferentiated contact forms create more uncertainty. Routing by need is faster for the visitor and easier to maintain.

items.question: How should external support destinations be handled?
items.answer: Always label them clearly so visitors know when they are leaving the main marketing shell.

items.question: What if support volume grows?
items.answer: This template is designed to absorb more specialized paths over time while keeping the first decision simple.

finalCta.title: Move back into product, roadmap, or community with confidence.
finalCta.text: Support is part of the premium experience. The next step should always feel obvious.
